items.html:
Rayad Emrit, an allrounder who bowls medium-pace, received his big break when he was included in the West Indies squad for an ODI tour of India a few months before the 2007 World Cup. He played only two games, though, and batted too low down the order to have significant impact and took no wickets. He hasn't received a national call-up since but he's been in Trinidad and Tobago's scheme of things in all forms of the game. Emrit was among the privileged few to be included in the Stanford Superstars squad for the Stanford 20/20 for 20 but he wasn't part of the final XI for the winner-takes-all match against England.
Cricinfo Staff October 2009
